Continue development of lkh0802a/LOL-GM in managed Cloud when Codex usage and runtime are available. Use one implementation worker only; do not delegate to parallel agents. All game UI text and user-facing explanations must remain Korean.

At the start of every run, inspect the actual repository, current main, branches, open PRs, applicable rules, and the current main versions of docs/README.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. Read the relevant specification, decisions, architecture and source code. Do not assume previous local files, unpushed changes or temporary evidence still exist. docs/DEVELOPMENT.md is the single active guide, using numeric stages 1–13 and dotted task numbers. Preserve its COMPLETE approved inventory, decisions, acceptance conditions and remaining work, together with newer user instructions in this chat. This automation references that inventory; it does not replace or narrow it. Correct stale documentation using verified evidence, while preserving original records. Do not declare the entire scope complete after finishing only selected priorities.

Before editing, state the scope and estimated duration. Each hourly implementation run must finish the largest coherent 45–55-minute vertical slice, including code, focused acceptance, documentation and relevant checks. Combine related small tasks; split larger features at a substantial natural boundary and record the precise continuation. Merge, CI waiting, HTML synchronization and documentation alone do not count as an implementation slice. Handle direct documentation requests without counting them as a new hourly implementation slice. A bounded investigation may deliver reproducible evidence and a precise implementation continuation when genuine source or permission gaps prevent a safe fix; do not repeatedly substitute proposals for authorized implementation.

Use a separate branch and PR, checking for duplicate work and file conflicts first. Merge sequentially only after ALL required checks pass on the exact CURRENT PR head, including medical tests across four seed shards, both aggregates and verify. Attach every PR using the native attachment tool. Verify full CI and standalone synchronization on the exact resulting main commit, then validated artifacts and successful Pages publication. Maintain a playable website and directly downloadable current offline HTML from fully validated main. Distinguish successful workflow publication from an independently verified production HTTP response. After implementation and follow-through, immediately start the next coherent slice if another full 45–55 minutes of usage/runtime remains; otherwise record the exact next slice.

The match engine is the highest priority. Read and implement the complete 38-item engine inventory, eight source-audit candidates, all approved realism and convenience refinements across every domain, all thirteen narrative areas, league-office/country-tier-two/broadcast connections, club language and finance, manager careers, the full UI redesign, Analysis Room, radar charts and every approved detailed connection and additional idea. These are consolidated existing tasks, not duplicate feature counts. Registration, feature names and module counts are not implementation evidence. Verify actual state writers, consumers, UI actions and save continuity, including sources, units, ownership, uncertainty, permissions, tradeoffs, counterexamples, rollback and AI/player parity.

Keep manual manager authority by default. Clubs decide their working language and related support spending under the latest approved rules. Language proficiency and adaptation affect recruitment and execution through verified consumers; distinguish language from nationality, activity region and local eligibility. FM is a reference for workflows and information hierarchy, not copied assets or wording. Keep primary navigation at the top for mobile usability. The initial screen contains only New Start, Load and Settings; career selection follows New Start. Initial recruitment must connect legitimate observed ability, details, comparison, sorting and filters, with regional candidates shown by default and separate access to all overseas candidates. Keep save/load as a utility action and the match-review item column removed. The complete UI redesign, Analysis Room and language systems remain unfinished until their real acceptance conditions pass.

Do not invent prices, fees, effect coefficients, unknown crowd-control timings, real Riot policies, professional targets or unavailable mechanics. Do not disclose hidden opponent ability or private practice, force winners or simulate amateur matches. Use only organized professional competition for empirical calibration; patch-pinned Riot mechanics are separate permitted static sources. Validate provenance, license, date, patch, event, tier, side, role, game IDs, duplicates, missing data and units, preserving raw evidence. Aggregate simulation is not exact spell execution or geometry. Gold alone must never declare a winner: use actual nexus destruction and report bounded unresolved failures honestly. Ordinary purchases require the player's own-base shop; only reviewed patch-specific Ornn passive exceptions may permit non-consumable crafting elsewhere. Obtain missing rule metadata before defining new timers or coefficients.

Optimize demonstrated bottlenecks only, with bounded representative baselines, before/after measurements and outcome parity where applicable. Distinguish intentional corrections from behavior-preserving optimizations. Preserve deterministic seeds, version boundaries, history, saves, permissions and rollback. Preserve ALL failures, diagnostics, raw sources and decisions. Before removing genuinely obsolete documentation, verify references, callers, build and save compatibility. Never delete game history or evidence, hide failures, remove instrumentation, change production garbage collection, raise budgets, change billing, add paid runners or claim compute is free. If usage, approval, network, repository or permissions block work, report the exact blocker and do safe read-only preparation without bypassing restrictions.

Defer long 100-season, device, mobile and TalkBack final QA until feature implementation and user playtest feedback/fixes are complete. Focused browser, responsive-layout, keyboard and accessibility checks are permitted. After all approved features have source-backed acceptance, continue with bounded product/UI/engine refinement: reproduce and fix concrete defects, disconnected controls, inconsistencies and measured bottlenecks. Continue meaningful idea discovery without a quota, merge duplicates, and distinguish proposals, untested hypotheses, reproduced defects, implemented changes, CI success, merge and deployment. After authorized implementation/refinement is complete, wait for meaningful user feedback and priorities. Notify only meaningful completion, failure, new evidence or required action; stay quiet when nothing has changed.
